name: Bacon Wrapped Water Chestnuts
description: Sweet and savory bacon-wrapped water chestnuts marinated overnight in a mixture of soya sauce and brown sugar.

recipeInstructions.text: Brown bacon and cut in half.
Roll water chestnuts in white sugar, wrap with bacon, and secure with toothpicks.
Mix brown sugar and soya sauce together.
Pour mixture over bacon-wrapped water chestnuts and marinate overnight.
Bake at 350°F for 30 minutes.

keywords: bacon-wrapped water chestnuts, sweet and savory, appetizer

_similar.name: Water Chestnuts Wrapped in Bacon
_similar.description: Bacon-wrapped water chestnuts marinated in a savory mixture of soya sauce and Worcestershire sauce, then baked until crispy.

recipeInstructions.text: Marinate bacon in soya sauce, Worcestershire sauce, garlic salt, and minced onions for 1 hour.
Wrap bacon around chestnuts and secure with toothpicks.
Cook in a 350°F oven until bacon is done.

_similar.name: Rumaki
_similar.description: Classic rumaki appetizer featuring bacon-wrapped water chestnuts baked in a ketchup and brown sugar glaze.

recipeInstructions.text: Cut the pound of bacon in half.
Wrap bacon around chestnuts and secure with toothpicks.
Bake at 350°F for ½ hour.
Drain grease.
Mix ketchup and brown sugar.
Pour mixture over chestnuts and bake for another ½ hour.

_similar.name: Roasted Chestnuts
_similar.description: Tender and flavorful roasted chestnuts seasoned with butter, salt, and cinnamon.

recipeInstructions.text: Preheat oven to 375°F.
Cut a ½-inch crisscross on the flat side of each chestnut, ensuring the cut goes through the nut to prevent explosion during baking.
Place the scored chestnuts in a shallow baking pan and bake for 25 to 30 minutes.
Allow the chestnuts to cool, then peel off the shells.
In a skillet, melt the butter over high heat and sauté the peeled chestnuts until well coated.
Transfer the skillet to the oven and roast until the chestnuts are golden on top.
Sprinkle with salt and cinnamon to taste before serving.

_similar.keywords: roasted chestnuts, savory snack, holiday appetizer

_similar.name: Bacon Broccoli Salad
_similar.description: A hearty broccoli salad with crispy bacon, red onion, and a tangy dressing featuring low-fat yogurt and feta cheese.

recipeInstructions.text: Combine the broccoli, red onion, sunflower seeds, raisins, and crumbled bacon in a large salad bowl.
In a separate bowl, mix together the yogurt, mayonnaise, sugar, and lemon juice to make the dressing.
Pour the dressing over the salad ingredients and toss to coat.
Refrigerate for 2 hours to allow the flavors to meld.

_similar.keywords: broccoli salad, bacon salad, yogurt dressing

_similar.name: Spinach Dip
_similar.description: A creamy spinach dip made with sour cream, mayonnaise, and Knorr vegetable soup mix, served in a hollowed-out pumpernickel bread loaf.
recipeIngredient: 1 pkg (300 g) frozen chopped spinach, thawed and drained
1 can (10 oz) water chestnuts, drained and chopped

recipeInstructions.text: Squeeze excess moisture from the thawed spinach.
In a bowl, combine the spinach, sour cream, mayonnaise, Knorr soup mix, water chestnuts, and green onions. Stir until well combined.
Cover and refrigerate for at least 2 hours to allow flavors to blend.
If using a bread loaf, scoop out a large hollow through the top and fill with the dip mixture. Serve with bread cubes cut from the centre and/or assorted fresh vegetables.

_similar.keywords: spinach dip, party appetizer, pumpernickel bread
